duration_calibration.basis: Same subprocess.run(aplay) wall timer; launch/drain overhead is positive. Failed campaign-04 numeric timers were not retained; no invented values.

blocks.design: Settled quiet before each volume cold reply; canonical2s probe after live block disconnect at unchanged gain/volume, before restore. Probe cannot run with media_ready; does not condition cold reply. Soak has an additional setup baseline, not a qualification control.

blocks.order: -6 dB first: 10 echo + 10 Stops + 10 sentences + 2 in-window; 0 dB: 10 echo + 5 Stops + 5 sentences.
blocks.capture_pairs: Pairs(2,3),(4,5) per volume share pre/postquiet capture. Request second+1s after BotStopped; independently measure actual MIC3 gap and require0<gap<2s. No export or5s sleep within pair;16echo captures.
blocks.design_firm_label: Existing -6 dB fixtures/cells unchanged; reported as firm.

blocks.capture: Bounded <=28 s capture; export timeout from declared preflight: 2.6 * measured capture seconds + 5 s. Fixed requests every 60 s. Resource samples every 10 s outside export, forced immediately before/after; <=45 s only across export.

blocks.noise_policy: Original ten request offsets remain fixed and 60 s apart; independent noise/harness retries follow the full600s interval under the same combined2-retry lifetime budget. All generations remain audited.

timing.afe_configuration: MR, filter 4, FD low-cost, unchanged framer; remeasure delay after any AFE/framer/mode change, never optimize ERLE delay
timing.anchor_method: interval-bracket-v1; first anchor, >=0.2 s wait, start capture; stop capture then final anchor. No serial receipt/sample-time equivalence. Require every edge block bracketed and mapped coverage of scored interval.
timing.latency_verdict: Use conservative upper bounds including mapping and near-onset uncertainty; missing bounds unscorable/fail. Report lower bounds even when negative.
timing.capture_window: Core isolated cells and quick-gap pairs share >=2.3s pre-roll and >=2s quiet post-roll; record<=28s including timeout/slow reconnect. Stop record before joining workers/export. Live callback has24s workload deadline plus4s stop reserve. Never wrap30s ring. Bounded soak exports only between fixed requests.

noise_gate.policy: Coordinator step-9-coordinator-decisions-3, option (a): v3 filters each quiet window and settled baseline independently with the declared fourth-order Butterworth 100 Hz high-pass. Reference the +6 dB rise rule to max(filtered baseline, -61 dBFS), restoring the effective -55 dBFS RMS ceiling; absolute -55 and maximum20ms -46 limits unchanged. Two lifetime re-attempts and three-distinct-consecutive pause unchanged. Preserve full-band and MIC1/MIC3 low-pass100 diagnostics. MIC1-only low-frequency component has unresolved, silence-dependent origin; MIC3 is clean. Campaign-01 verdicts immutable; no old cells reused or performance retries.

opportunity.eligible: Clean complete delivery; independently matched near onset; guard open over entire +/-20 ms onset uncertainty on source capture timeline; every intersecting MIC3 frame active; >=100 ms verified future far-end speech from source/MIC3 match.
opportunity.near_match: Use existing fixed-delay AFE/source correlation: |r|>=0.25 and >=1.1 times competing peak outside +/-640 samples; no fit of AFE delay; polarity inversion permitted. Report independent raw corroboration and gap flags.
opportunity.in_window: Any guard-closed overlap of onset uncertainty is in-window, reported separately with requested/actual offsets, muted speech duration bounds, transcript/WER and interruption. Cannot count against or improve out-of-window score.
opportunity.no_opportunity: Only witnessed MIC3 silence over onset uncertainty with otherwise complete evidence excludes the cell from eligible denominator. Retain in declared denominator. Unknown/partial coverage, undelivered stimulus, missing near onset and insufficient future speech are not pauses.
opportunity.future_failure: Keep existing unscorable-future class for missing or <100 ms verified future; expected count 0. A continuous >=4 s source is intended to prevent it; never retrospectively reclassify.
opportunity.allowed_unscorable: Seven ordered Stop and six sentence spares per gated -6dB voice block; 0dB retains two per kind. unscorable-lull-cancelled consumes a spare without credit, but its campaign-wide expected count is zero: any occurrence fails even if a replacement succeeds. All other unscorable classes and rules unchanged.
opportunity.denominator_rule: Strict eligible and ongoing-reply-lull jointly count toward ten eligible per kind per voice class at -6dB (five reported at 0dB); report their recognition, interruption and success rates separately. Eligible performance misses stay in denominator and never consume spares. Only independently classified unscorable-*, no-opportunity or not-delivered-no-active-tts may consume the next spare of the same kind/volume/voice. Retain originals and spares; exhausted budget fails denominator. In-window probes stay separate; no retrospective credit.
opportunity.ongoing_reply_lull: Second eligible stratum, ongoing-reply-lull: mixed MIC3 onset uncertainty E=near-20ms through L=near+20ms; outer inactive span <=5 complete 20ms frames, including active middle frames, complete active left/right closures and gap-free coverage; right closure ends <=L+120ms. Two disjoint pre-E 200ms same-context/source matches agree within 2 samples. Complete active source continuation (>1024 LSB^2) covers/follows L, starts <=L+120ms and was successfully written before the lower host bound of E; last pre-written sample maps strictly beyond closure. Reference activity remains >max(4 LSB^2,quiet-max-power*10^0.6). Earliest cancellation must not precede closure; otherwise unscorable-lull-cancelled. Missing capture closure remains unscorable-mic3. All upstream, guard, near match and >=100ms verified future-speech requirements remain.

echo.scope: Every clean core echo reply; two cold replies total
echo.median_frame_reduction: Report separately, no replacement for integrated criterion
echo.afe_residual: Report whole/first500/post-guard and max20ms after every unguarded re-onset
echo.basis: PLAN 9 proposals; clean step-3 worst selected-gain integrated22.30/first50017.93 dB; step5 post-open residual -54..-67dBFS. These are proposed per-reply bounds, not already demonstrated for every cold/live content case.

false_turns.scope: All echo-only opportunities, including cold replies and quick gaps; soak echo-only windows add observations but cannot replace core cells. Proposed events retained separately.
false_turns.basis: Steps5/6/8b observed zero; re-onset leak in step6 motivates max20ms residual reporting.

barge_in.stop_recognition: Normalized transcript contains complete word stop; unrelated/interim duplicate text not double-counted
barge_in.credited: Recognition AND accepted interruption after near onset AND a strict eligible or ongoing-reply-lull opportunity with verified future speech. Both strata must meet the same latency, flush, integrity and success gates; natural end is not a flush. unscorable-lull-cancelled has no credit and must occur zero times across all hold rows, including replaced/report-only rows.
barge_in.basis: User decision 2026-10-17 decisions13 Part B6: 23 retained finite Stop bounds (15 step-8, 8 eligible campaign-04), max upper 1.095157s. Fable audit: varying Flux turn decision, stable device-plus-transport stage about 0.3-0.45s. Stop upper bound 1.2s; full intervals still reported. Sentence 2s and independent 9/10 per kind/class unchanged. Historical evidence receives no new credit.
barge_in.voice_class_rule: Independent 10 eligible and >=9 successes per kind for each voice class at -6dB, pooling strict eligible and ongoing-reply-lull within that group only. Report the two strata separately; cannot pool firm/normal or exchange spares. Any cancelled-lull row fails the campaign zero-count requirement.

flush.window: An active, gap-free block of the old MIC3 reference must have an upper device bound within 300ms before callback (callback-300000us <= upper < callback); select the last such active block. User amendment decisions14 permits a later phonetic lull; source-tail and post-callback checks unchanged. Same old context must have a complete active source frame (>1024 LSB^2) beyond last old MIC3 sample, covered by successful non-silent transport writes no later than callback host upper bound. Source alignment and write coverage required; natural end fails. Legacy candidate-block certainty remains diagnostic. Post-callback 100ms/250ms/zero-stale limits unchanged.
flush.new_onset_integrity: Prefix-loss <=20ms and signed correlation reported only; missing diagnostic is labelled, not a qualification gate.
flush.cutoff_spike: Report adjacent-sample cut step vs max(32LSB,2x preceding180ms), clips and uncertainty; report only.
flush.basis: Existing100/250ms flush and1s non-silent-onset bounds retained. Prefix20ms and2x cut-step are report-only; exact prefix-loss bound may be unscorable and is not invented from correlation.

missing_playback.anchor: First non-silent context-attributed TTS chunk written to transport
missing_playback.coverage: Every attempted reply throughout campaign, including next replies/reconnect/soak; absent non-silent write is a failed missing-output attempt, not removed.
missing_playback.diagnostic_anchor: BotStarted server-to-DAC separately; never score this as device-only delay.
missing_playback.basis: Step3 coordinator anchor correction; step8 max positive-onset upper457.72ms, step8c all three witnessed.
missing_playback.source_template_basis: Detect first >1024 LSB^2 20ms frame and cut the unchanged 4000-sample template after the candidate-config causal second-order playback high-pass; source only, MIC3 unchanged. Non-silent transport-write anchor and 1s limit unchanged.

near_preservation.measure: Raw MIC1 vs pre-gate AFE on fixed-delay known near-only extent, <=1dB absolute attenuation.
near_preservation.basis: Step1 frozen bound; step3 clean controls0.0875..0.0941dB. No double-talk mixture ratio called attenuation.

reference_health.low_samples: Report all deltas and longest run even below100ms; any unscorable/inaudible check has no health credit
reference_health.mask: Gap-free block audible at both conservative capture bounds; independent MIC3/known extent for acoustic activity
reference_health.calibration: Per-gain quiet before cold reply; canonical direct DAC probe after live block disconnect, unchanged gain/volume, before restore. Direct probe is rejected by firmware when media_ready. Retain source/MIC3 central1.6s normalized ratio and clip checks.
reference_health.basis: Step3 canonical calibration; relative floor31.623ppm at15dB vs expected~3052..4679ppm absolute. This freezes a diagnostic acceptance obligation, not DAC proof or runtime fallback.

guard.speech_onset: Gate closed before first MIC3 frame within20dB of reply peak; retain2LSB onset only as diagnostic.
guard.rearm_rule: Guard required only after >=2s local silence; record spacing and all unguarded re-onsets. Exactly one closure for continuous reply; do not require another on a <2s gap.
report: first400ms integrated residual and max20ms residual after every re-onset
guard.basis: Step5 historical24% muted -> rearm2s; step8 closures502..614ms with tightenedclock, max20ms re-onset residual-44.08dBFS; step8b speech-level guard definition. Do not use obsolete600..660ms closure as new gate.

resources.playback_floor_formula: max(4096,ceil(configured_stack_bytes/4));4288 for17152-byte stack; recompute from candidate, report margin
resources.cpu_rule: Require>=25% in every >=5s steady window; <20% is hard stop,20..25 still fails acceptance. Short windows reported but cannot qualify CPU.
resources.display: Character enabled throughout connect/Ready/postReady/every scored block/soak; posts increase; errors/display send failures/DMA errors/gate timeouts zero; no artificial24fps requirement
resources.sampling: Connect/Ready/postReady, pre/post each capture, after Stop, per epoch including disconnect finalPERF; soak every10s outside export and immediately pre/post export. Export timeout from declared preflight (2.6*capture_seconds+5s), resource-gap ceiling45s only during export and existing30s elsewhere; CPU/heap/stack floors unchanged and all export windows included.
resources.basis: Step2 floors unchanged; with-cat step8 internal84508B margin2588B; playback4504 floor4288 margin216; reconnect peer-rx1508 floor1024. Do not substitute step8e no-cat heap90828B.
resources.soak_margin: Step8 display-active minimum84508B: margin2588B above81920B; soak probes this thin margin, floor unchanged.

hardware.startup_rx_overflows: Retain separately before Ready; no post-Ready overrun allowed; capture gap_blocks must always be0 in scored captures
hardware.render_ledger: At every valid active RenderTick snapshot and each post-Stop/post-silent-cancel/new-epoch boundary: submitted_samples-completed_samples ==640-completed_samples%320. Reset/preload/drained points explicitly labeled, never substituted for required active witnesses.
hardware.ledger_basis: PERF captures pre-write state; post-write is960-completed%320. Ring model supports mechanism; original driver event was not instrumented.
hardware.abort: First nonzero absolute hardware fault fails and ends hold, never a missing/not-run success.

transport.loss_denominator: Received packet delta in same active epoch/window; report missing-slot lost and late/playout-dropped separately, and union of unusable sequence IDs where available; no double counting cancellation
transport.scope: Every scored reply and entire active epoch/soak; reconnect block separately requires0 lost/concealed/I2S deltas in both epochs
transport.observers: SCTP, UDP/authenticated RTP, downlink send and device arrival rings healthy, supported, no unavailable/truncated/disk-failure records; drain rings often enough, keep observer health at every seal. Required missing witness fails.
transport.attribution: Preserve send pacing, socket/authenticated arrival gaps, device arrival bursts, WiFi observations; never claim AP/air versus driver separation without independent witness.
transport.loss_numerator_policy: Require (missing-slot lost + playout_dropped) / received <=0.02 as conservative unusable-packet gate in each window, even if overlap inflates it; additionally retain unique sequence union when available. Explicit cancellation retired slots/arrivals excluded from both counters. Coordinator decisions18 preserves the conservative numerator; no post-hoc dedup waiver.
transport.burst_witness: Per-window missing_run_ended[1,2,3,4,5,>=6] deltas in one generation/peer with ordered device snapshots. finished=sum(k*delta[k]); open=max(0,lost_delta-finished); burst=max(largest ended bucket,open). Burst, buckets and open remainder are report-only in every transport record and analysis summary. Positive >=6 delta, absent/malformed/mismatched/decreasing histogram, post-PLC zeros delta !=0 or starvation delta !=0 fail closed. Never use a lifetime absolute maximum.
transport.rationale: Coordinator decisions18: the AEC reference is the actual DAC output including PLC, so concealed runs do not bias echo/barge-in metrics; post-PLC silence would, and remains a hard gate. The PLAN no-burst>3 playback rule moves to separate downlink-quality work (paused diag-01 / jitter depth), outside echo acceptance. This prospective v8.3 policy does not rescore v8.2 acceptance. All non-transport gates, probe-own rule, reconnect zero-loss checks and retake/environmental policies are unchanged; retransmission-aware server_pacing remains a draft.

admission_liveness_sctp.per_reply_device_received_and_dispatched: Recorder downstream RTVIProcessor outgoing count in same window, not counters-only equality
admission_liveness_sctp.drain_budget_start: After initial PERF read; retain every observation, bounded queue drain only, no acoustic retry
admission_liveness_sctp.per_reply_pongs: positive ping and pong deltas; pongs>=pings-1 and outstanding0..1 at boundary. One in-flight allowance cannot hide an alarm or a stopped sequence.
admission_liveness_sctp.sctp_patch: aiortc1.15.0 source guard must be enabled; every active T3 followed within active epoch by same-pc_id post-SACK flight=sent_queue=outbound_queue=0. Post-teardown ACK cannot cure active failure.
admission_liveness_sctp.interrupt_delivery: Record both copies, TSNs, first-send ACK/loss, callback device_us and duplicate no-op; required accepted interrupt must reach callback within flush upper bounds.
admission_liveness_sctp.cookie_echo: Count per epoch; diagnostic, not automatic failure.

proactive_tts.metric_coverage: Every actual TTS generation including all real-bot next replies and soak; zero leading silence>=0.8s. Context metrics and writes must reconcile.
proactive_tts.private_guard: Exact pipecat1.12.0 and both Flux source hashes; record resolved supported state before acquisition. Guards remain fail-closed, but a refusal fails pinned campaign.
proactive_tts.cold_and_reconnect: No proactive reconnect scheduled before first generation in any new session; no reconnect interval intersects device-disconnect-through-new-Ready interval. Suppress scheduling after End/Cancel; retain already-running work and fail prohibited overlap.
proactive_tts.after_stop: Real bot LLM answer with no scripted delay or follow-up. Record LLM request and context-attributed TTS request, first write, metric start, wait and Stop-to-first-write for every subsequent context.
proactive_tts.request_first_write_gate: Report TTS-context-request (entry before in-flight reconnect wait) and nearest script/real-LLM request to first context-attributed write; no scripted follow-up delay. This is diagnostic, not a borrowed aggregate40ms guarantee.
proactive_tts.basis: 8d A5/8long B0/8;8e A4/8long B0/8, firstwrite+16.5ms overall butg4+149.3ms. Local-cleanup fix host-tested only; step9 is live verification.

reconnect.active_disconnect: Every MIC3 frame intersecting disconnect bracket active, width<=100ms, gap-free. Fixed deadline, no snapshot/boundary call inside continuously50ms-anchored interval.
reconnect.new_epoch: Different pc_id and generation; fresh first snapshot prefills==1; bracketed non-silent playback bothepochs; do not require unobservable0->1pre-RTPprefill
reconnect.boundaries: Old finalPERF from disconnect; new firstPERF after finalcaptureanchor; both drained; positive ping/pong witnesses per epoch through subsequent observation; per-epoch peer-rx>=1024
reconnect.faults: Zero loss/concealment/I2S delta in bothepochs; allglobalresources/ledger/lead/proactiveguards also pass
reconnect.basis: 8c reconnect functionally healthy but active-disconnect unproven;8c fixes added host-tested anchored block. No old witness credited as acceptance.

sentence_overlap.measure: Report independently witnessed real overlap duration per sentence under normal bot interruption policy; no sustained double-talk block.

quick_gap.witness: Independent MIC3 silence gap strictly >0 and <2 s

rf.accounting: Total RX+TX, no board-flow subtraction, no new qdisc/privileges. Missing/reset counters fail pre-gate. Retain /proc/net/dev before/after and monotonic times. Reapply before each hold; capture same counters during scored windows. Per-cell pre-gate uses the existing 5 s settling interval (no extra soak request delay); retryable before stimulus, never inferred from a performance miss.
rf.independent_invalidity: Per-cell RF pre-gate failure consumes shared noise/harness budget after clean device checks. During-capture or whole-hold RF failure remains a failed hold; never infer RF from loss, ERLE, recognition or SCTP T3.
rf.permissions: No sudo, CAP_NET_RAW, tcpdump, netem, routes, AP or hardware changes. Any unavailable kernel/channel-utilization witness stays unavailable, with no AP/air/lwIP causal claim.
rf.diagnostic_boundaries: Invoke wifi-stats before every campaign admission boundary and retain command timing, status and raw log; evidence only, no new gate. This dump is driver RX/TX/buffer statistics, not the separate wifi-observe TX-completion ring.
rf.blind_spot: Host wlp8s0 was a 5 GHz channel36 STA while the board used 2.4 GHz channel6 on the bench network in campaign-01. The host byte-volume pre-gate cannot observe the device 2.4 GHz channel or distinguish AP/air from device radio/driver; a PASS does not establish link health. RF policy unchanged.

failure_policy.acquisition_errors: Retain all failures. Only explicitly classified harness failures share the noise budget, after clean resource/I2S/liveness/delivery/admission/observer checks. All other acquisition failures stop.
abort_immediately: Nonzero hardware I2S errors/timeouts/underflows, failed allocation or resource-floor violation
Observer loss/truncation, invalid timing other than one marked capture-gap block, or persistent admission backlog
Liveness alarm or active transport error; noise pauses only after three consecutive distinct contaminated cells.
failure_policy.performance_failures: Keep each declared recognition/acoustic miss in denominator. Continue remaining safe cells; no score-driven retakes or threshold changes. An early-ended hold remains failed and cannot qualify on its survivors.
failure_policy.post_seal: Record last-case seal and active end before teardown per pc_id. Post-boundary errors, T3 and liveness alarms retained/count per session; cannot cure active failures, excluded only from active-generation gates. Explicitly report whole-session-not-clean when present.
failure_policy.retakes: No performance retakes; <=2 noise/harness re-attempts combined. Seven Stop and six sentence opportunity spares per gated -6dB voice block; report-only 0dB two each. Eligibility witness and ten-eligible denominators unchanged.

harness_retries.resume: Only unacquired IDs; carry lifetime attempts and ordered spare use from hash-bound prior run. A new environmental hold resets the streak, not budgets. Completed misses are never reacquired; hard faults remain failures.

failure_policy.serial_host_resume: On every exception attempt finish best-effort and record error_class. A serial-or-host exception may resume only after completed integrity audit, normal-image hash verification, restored mixer and released lock. Incomplete attempts consume the same lifetime budget; completed/scored cells never repeat. Device/observer/resource/liveness faults stay refused.

conditions: Only transport fails; resources/admission/RF/delivery pass, all delivery deltas and I2S zero, observer healthy

Liveness intact: timeout delta zero, pongs >= pings - 1, no alarm/ErrorFrame/FatalErrorFrame/evaluation-error; no failed/refused or stimulus/reply-generation-overlapping TTS reconnect. Completed proactive cycles between reply generations are allowed and reported.

F1b: device alive = starvation delta 0, liveness intact, resources intact. Report post_plc_zeros; nonzero requires no speech packet due or wholly late (Ingress for EVERY missing Render slot if trace enabled, else counter late==missing). No per-cell score, burst-bound or retry-cap relaxation.
Required downlink ring contiguous seq with <=60 ms maximum gap and edge coverage; required SCTP ring has no T3/Abort in attempt window

Required untruncated socket RTP ring: window-local delay excursion >=3 consecutive host seconds each max delay >=120ms, with >=25 packets >100ms in a sliding 5s span within the run, inside the full before/after attempt window (including export). Scored-cell overlap is diagnostic only. Any >=1s inter-arrival/endpoint stall refuses classification.
Both host RF byte gates pass
transport_environmental.exclusion: Retain raw witnesses in acquisition-failure.json, no acoustic analysis, no credit/spares/opportunity. Shared lifetime <=2 noise/harness retries; 3 consecutive distinct noisy/environmental cells pause.
transport_environmental.recovery: Take retry-check-2 >=5s after retry-check; transport must pass on that clean interval. Resources/delivery/admission/I2S/liveness remain clean across the entire attempt/recovery.
transport_environmental.epoch: Consecutive device boundary intervals, excluding only wholly contained before->retry-check-2 spans of witnessed retry-safe environmental attempts; raw first->last transport remains diagnostic. All other epoch checks unchanged.
transport_environmental.cap: Exceeding 3 per physical hold or 6 across the campaign/resume chain pauses after durable journal write; lifetime budgets remain.
transport_environmental.window: From before-boundary host start through after-boundary completion; ring inputs selected by pc_id and monotonic time.
transport_environmental.bucket_basis: Unique missing IDs, expected-range ratio, reorder depth, inter-arrival gap, per-second delay table and naive forward-gap sum are reported diagnostics. Reorder-aware sequence and RTP timestamp unwrap; missing/truncated evidence fails closed.

delay_excursion.baseline: percentile(observed_ms - unwrapped timestamp/48), computed only on this attempt before/after window
delay_excursion.bucket_basis: floor(observed_ms/1000), fixed integer host seconds; runs cannot bridge missing seconds; inclusive sliding 5s span inside run
delay_excursion.co_timing: Use packets observed inside the full before/after attempt counter window. Passed = valid and not stall and excursion_count >=1. overlaps_cell/overlapping_cells are diagnostics, never eligibility conditions.

transport_environmental.reconnect_reply_basis: Existing context metric lifecycle: tts-generation-metric-start through its unique tts-generation-stopped/tts-interruption-stopped. Buffered playback and delayed BotStopped notifications are not TTS generation overlap. Actual Jabra request_monotonic_s through elapsed_seconds is the stimulus window. Missing/ambiguous lifecycle endpoints fail closed.
transport_environmental.export_diagnostic: Retain capture_end_s and after_boundary_s in attempt-window.json. Per-excursion during_export is overlap of its host-second interval with capture_end_s..after_boundary_s; missing timing reports null, never false. If all environmental attempts have an export-tail excursion, flag EXPORT-LOAD HYPOTHESIS prominently for re-examination before further use; report-only, no gate.

harness_retry_admission.recorder_end: host timestamp immediately before retry-check stats command minus transit allowance
harness_retry_admission.rule: received_delta and dispatched_delta >= recorder count; equal device received/dispatched; zero drop deltas; no +/-1 tolerance; retain endpoints

8.coverage: Active-TTS no-pause>=4s source; independent opportunity classification andin-windowloss; volume0levelblocked; failedI2Sholdretained; committedrunner

8b.coverage: Speech-level guard within20dBpeak plus2LSBdiagnostic; trimoff; no historicaldataqualification

8e.coverage: Local-cleanup defaulton,pinnedbot; allgenerationlead<0.8; nooverlap/refusal/failure; nextfirstwriteperStop; cold/device-reconnectexclusions; displayactiveheap

pending_before_freeze: Prepare the immutable v8.4 draft, not adoption. Coordinator alone creates USER-ADOPTED after user adoption, including counting the lull stratum toward ten eligible; packaging review and reconciliation with campaign-07 remain pending.
deferred: Physical acoustic stop latency without external witness
Full gain grid and full async recorder
User real-talker measurement and possible appended0dB10+10 qualification

cleanup.rule: Future holds own flock through full normal-image restore and boot hash verification, stop owned bot, restore saved Jabra mixer byte-for-byte, then release. Never touch 7860. No bench use in specification phase.

measurement_contract.activity_mask: Known source extent AND MIC3 power >max(4LSB^2, max20ms quiet reference power*10^(6/10)) at same gain. Independent of AFE/uplink. First500ms begins at independent reference onset; complete frames only.
measurement_contract.reduction: 10log10(sum raw active energy/sum alignedAFE active energy), and frame median separately; raw index+1024 ->AFE. Quiet-floor clipping/zeros never rescue missing data.
measurement_contract.stt: Freeze expected text and normalized word edit distance; WER<=0.20, whole-wordStop; record both STT transcript and accepted interruption, never call transcript alone barge-in.
measurement_contract.reference_onsets: Keep independent per-gain activity mask forecho; speech-levelguard uses within20dB replyMIC3peak, a separate purpose.
measurement_contract.first500_source: First500ms source power from context PCM aligned independently by MIC3/source match; bound applies strictly above-30dBFS, quiet onsets reported.

rollout_after_acceptance.rollback: Separately authorized procedure test previous normal half-duplex9936da45 image plus ECHOEAR_AEC_FULL_DUPLEX=0. Verify boot/capability and bracketed playback/half-duplex policy, no stale AECclaim. This draft does not merge or deploy.

declaration_policy: Separate immutable file from this reviewed draft template; review_approval copies review_of_record, reviewed_spec_sha256 hashes the template. Resume requires a new declaration with resume_from binding the entire retained prior run; never overwrite either. v8.4 draft packaging is not user adoption. The launch script requires a regular non-symlink USER-ADOPTED file in the bundle before any environment query; only the coordinator creates it after the user decision. Declared/qualification/campaign_authorized fields in the frozen payload specify the conditional prospective runner contract, not approval to bypass the guarded launch.

console_export.source: Fable step-9 spec re-review defect 1: retained aux-1 7.34 s capture exported in 18.95 s; three channels.

real_reply.prompt_rule: Usually one short sentence, at most two; measured maximum is a planning bound, not a guarantee. Capture workload deadline remains 24 s.

source_preflight_contract.definition: Initial speech onset through the last active frame before the first silent run >100ms; leading/trailing silence excluded. Also report longest qualifying span and maximum silent run. Retained mono16kS16LE PCM and original declaration text/path/hash bound.

highpass_residual.scope: Filter contiguous AFE capture once before selecting unchanged reference-active masks and 1024-sample delayed output; report alongside full-band residuals; never used by gates.

stimulus_levels.scope: Matched near-source extent; raw MIC1 and pre-gate AFE(+1024 samples) active RMS. Double-talk windows include echo/residual and are not isolated near-end estimates. Unmatched/skipped/missing windows remain explicitly unscorable; no level gate.

time_estimate.basis: 206min v8.3 planning +14 added opportunity spares at90s =227min (3h47). Max-attempt planning and explicit timeout/overhead envelope are separate; no finite hard wall-clock guarantee.

v831_budget.limitation: No finite hard wall-clock maximum: host analysis/I/O, environmental holds/resumes and restore-failure lock retention are not bounded. Envelope is explicit planning, not a timeout guarantee.

link_probe.scope: Every physical hold after candidate boot and connected idle bot, before scheduled stimuli; no automatic restart/retry on failure.
diagnostics: unique missing count and expected-range ratio
reorder depth and naive forward-gap sum
link_probe.cleanup: Existing exception audit, bot stop, normal-image flash/boot-hash verification, mixer restore, lock release.
link_probe.interpretation: Sanity gate only, not a forecast of later RF quality. Time-of-day loss argument withdrawn; no excursion threshold gates the idle probe.
link_probe.idle_budget: 9 + 240 + 45 < pipecat.pipeline.worker.IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS; dependency-backed host regression, no bot override
link_probe.epoch_interpretation: Coordinator decisions-8: raw uplink unique-loss ratio <=0.005 and no >=1 s arrival/endpoint gap govern the entire probe boundary interval; no per-cell burst bound in that interval. Scored-capture and inter-capture intervals unchanged. Pending acceptance refreeze; device_alive unchanged.

first_hold_periodicity.counter_diagnostic: Report-only PERF late/missing counter sums and flagged pairs; only two adjacent qualifying-uplink cycles pause.
